refit.uncertainty_qualification: Local inverse weighted-Jacobian covariance conditional on this subset/protocol and independent initial coordinate errors. Residual-scaled widths use max(1, chi_square/dof), matching documented EosFit convention; neither is the original author covariance/confidence or total systematic uncertainty.
